description: Try to unsubscribe from the mailing list of a message, in order: (1) RFC 8058 one-click HTTPS POST, (2) automatic email to the List-Unsubscribe mailto address, (3) otherwise returns `method: "browser"` with the URL to open in a browser to finish manually, (4) `method: "none"` when no header exists. Deletes nothing. Preferably pass the `lastMessageId` returned by mail_senders_summary.

id.description: Id of a representative message of the newsletter

name: mail_unsubscribe
title: Unsubscribe
